sourceLines: No customer documents may leave the local machine
Only the verifier role may approve release evidence
Tools that write files require explicit workspace scope
A capability created by the builder cannot approve its own installation
Memory may influence planning but may never grant authority
High-risk tools require human approval for every execution
Self-improvement may not modify production directly
Network access is denied unless the destination is approved
